setup_distributed_process_group: setup a PyTorch distributed process group for SLURM or local multi-GPU training
cleanup_distributed: cleanup and destroy the initialized distributed process group and release ports
all_reduce_tensor: all_reduce a tensor across all processes with optional averaging enabled
all_gather_tensors: all_gather tensors from all processes into a list of tensors
broadcast_object_list: broadcast a list of pickleable objects from a source rank to all processes
